profile.name: MERLIN STUWART
profile.tagline: Building full-stack & AI-powered applications with Python, React.js, RAG systems, and LLMs.

summary: Junior Software Developer with 1+ year of hands-on experience building full-stack and AI-powered applications using Python, React.js, JavaScript, REST APIs, MySQL, and MongoDB. Delivered a production WhatsApp automation bot that cut manual agent response time by ~40%, and built RAG pipelines and fine-tuned LLMs for domain-specific Q&A systems. Trained Python Full-Stack Developer (JSpiders, 2023-2024) with a strong foundation in OOP, SDLC, and Agile/Scrum.

experiences.title: Junior Software Developer
experiences.description: Independently designed and delivered a client-facing WhatsApp automation bot (production rollout). Integrated AI/ML components including LLMs and RAG pipelines into business apps. Developed full-stack features using Python, React.js, REST APIs, MySQL, and MongoDB.

experiences.title: Project Management Intern
experiences.description: Supported the Project Management team in tracking Salesforce-based project deliverables, gaining hands-on exposure to CRM workflows, documentation, and cross-team coordination.

projects.title: WhatsApp Business Automation Bot (Autosherpa)
projects.description: Docker-containerized WhatsApp bot handling leads, bookings, and support workflows for real client deployment.
highlights: Cut manual agent response time by ~40% in production.
Reduced first-response time from minutes to seconds with AI intent classification.
Fully containerized with Docker for seamless 24/7 cloud server deployment.
Integrated with backend APIs for real-time lead & booking state management.
projects.architecture: Python Backend → WhatsApp Cloud API → AI Intent Engine → Docker Container

projects.title: WhatsApp Automation Desktop Application
projects.description: Built a cross-platform desktop control app enabling non-technical staff to control and monitor multiple bot instances.
highlights: Real-time session monitoring with start/stop controls for multiple bot instances.
Designed clean IPC communication between Electron renderer and background Node.js processes.
Built tailored dashboard UI eliminating manual agent oversight.
Packaged executable for Windows desktop deployment.
projects.architecture: Electron UI (Renderer) ↔ IPC Bridge ↔ Node.js Automation Runner

projects.title: NEET Preparation Assistant — Fine-Tuned LLM
projects.description: Domain-specific Q&A and doubt-solving assistant fine-tuned on NEET Physics, Chemistry, and Biology syllabus.
highlights: Fine-tuned open-weights LLM using domain-specific NEET medical exam dataset.
Outperformed generic LLM baselines on complex science doubt-solving accuracy.
Implemented structured prompt templates for step-by-step problem explanations.
Optimized model inference latency for interactive student Q&A.
projects.architecture: NEET Syllabus Dataset → Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) → Domain LLM Inference API

projects.title: Suryajosvi Reflection Trackers
projects.description: Full-stack AI-powered reflection tracker retrieving personalized insights from personal journal entries.
highlights: Built end-to-end RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline over user journal vector embeddings.
Integrated vector database for fast semantic similarity search across historical reflections.
Developed responsive React dashboard with real-time insight visualizer.
Containerized backend & vector database services with Docker Compose.
projects.architecture: React Frontend ↔ FastAPI ↔ Vector Database (Embeddings) ↔ RAG Pipeline ↔ LLM
